scope: C03 K01 그림자 보완/K05 스마트폰 보완/K06 두 파일 내부 기록 비교용 첫 프레임 3개. 기존 V8 PNG 및 영상 원본 불변.
generation_mode: built-in image_gen, one separate generation per scene

entries.final_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a single 16:9 photorealistic Korean commercial film first frame, scene C03 K01. Edit/reframe the supplied reference photograph, keeping exactly the same woman R, face, low black ponytail, beige blouse, teal-blue vest, dark charcoal trousers, outdoor delivery-yard setting, silver table, gray binder, architectural papers, transparent glass of water, and single black smartphone. Change the camera to a moderately high three-quarter medium shot tilted downward: clearly show her face and upper body, both hands, the tabletop and a broad area of industrial concrete yard behind the table; crop ALL sky and horizon out. It must still look like a real outdoor delivery area, with subtle concrete slab joints and a small hint of low pallets at the distant edge, not a blank studio. She sits normally, attentive and calm, looking down at the paper. Her LEFT hand holds one thin flat rectangular black modern smartphone against her LEFT ear. Her RIGHT hand rests naturally near papers. Preserve plausible fingers and hands, visible phone silhouette, no curved telephone receiver, no cord, no duplicate phone. Bright natural sunlight evenly illuminates her face and tabletop. This is the BEFORE state: no large incoming shadow, no giant module or crane in frame, no looming shape. Ordinary natural small contact shadows are correct. Subsequent video will show a shadow from an offscreen module moving only across concrete, table and person, followed by her looking upward; do not depict that action yet. Natural realistic textures, premium but ordinary film lighting, the reference's visual identity and materials, physically believable perspective. One image only, no panels or collage, no captions, letters, logos, watermark, no new props. Wide 16:9 landscape frame.
entries.motion_camera_notes: 높은 3/4 카메라 고정. 밝은 첫 상태에서 R이 왼손 스마트폰 통화, 대사 뒤 화면 밖 모듈의 그림자가 콘크리트·탁자·인물 표면에만 이동. 마지막 위를 봄. 하늘/공중에 검은 막을 만들지 않음. 실제 그림자 동작은 후속 영상 검증 필요.

observations: 기존 R의 얼굴·검은 묶음머리·베이지 블라우스·청록 조끼를 유지.
높은 3/4 시점, 하늘과 수평선 없음. 바닥과 팔레트 일부로 야외 배송 구역 인지 가능.
회색 파일·도면·물컵·탁자 유지. 스마트폰 1개, 자연스러운 양손.
다가오는 큰 그림자와 모듈은 없는 시작 상태.
remaining_checks: 후속 영상의 그림자 표면 접촉/모양/이동과 위보기는 아직 생성·검증되지 않음.

entries.aspect_ratio_note: 약 16:9, 내장 도구 원본 치수 그대로 저장. 재인코딩·크롭 없음.

entries.final_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one 16:9 photorealistic commercial film first frame, C03 K05. Input reference 1 is the existing K05 scene, definitive set, wardrobe and props. Input reference 2 is the filmed scene, supporting body/space continuity. Recreate this SAME Korean woman R in her thirties, same face and black low ponytail, beige rolled-sleeve blouse, teal-blue tailored vest, dark charcoal trousers, in the SAME orange-framed portable-office workspace. Keep the messy table with laptop, architectural papers, closed orange folder, crumpled paper and white architecture model, wall pinned sketches/corrections, green plant, and open doorway toward industrial delivery yard. Camera is at a side-rear three-quarter medium position but sufficiently around her LEFT side to clearly see her LEFT ear, the left side of her face and her lips from the first frame. Her face starts already in a calm attentive three-quarter profile; no extreme twist of neck, head or torso. ESSENTIAL: exactly ONE flat thin modern BLACK RECTANGULAR SMARTPHONE, approximately 15 by 7 by 0.8 cm, in her LEFT hand against her LEFT ear. Expose its broad flat back and straight top/bottom/long outer edges clearly to camera. Her fingers grip only its edge, not covering the entire outline. It is recognizably a smartphone slab, absolutely not a handset or curved landline receiver, no bulky rounded ends, no cable, no phone base, no second device in either hand. Keep normal anatomically credible hands and five fingers, no extra limbs. Her RIGHT hand rests lightly on the top surface of the CLOSED ORANGE FOLDER lying FLAT on the table; the folder must not be lifted or opened. Preserve believable scale and proportions of the person and furniture, natural posture. This first frame precedes one short spoken question and still listening: the phone and folder remain fixed, no large head rotation, no complex object handling. Daylight and ordinary realistic interior lighting, same color/materials as reference. No captions, logos, readable text, watermark. Do not make a collage. Single wide 16:9 frame.
entries.motion_camera_notes: 측후면 3/4 카메라 고정. 얼굴의 입 프로필과 왼쪽 귀의 평평한 검은 스마트폰을 첫 프레임부터 노출. R은 한 문장 질문 후 입을 다물고 청취. 왼손 폰 위치·오른손·닫힌 주황 파일은 고정. 파일 들기/열기·큰 머리 회전은 이 컷에 넣지 않음.

observations: 기존 R의 인물/옷, 주황 문틀·도면 벽·노트북·모형·실내 공간 유지.
왼손 스마트폰 1개의 평평한 뒷면과 직사각 외곽이 명확. 케이블/전화기 본체 없음.
오른손은 닫힌 주황 파일 위, 파일은 탁자에 평평하게 놓임.
입의 옆모습이 노출되어 큰 머리 회전 없이 질문/청취 시작 가능.
remaining_checks: 후속 영상의 발음·립싱크·폰 및 손 형태 유지·파일 고정 여부는 아직 생성·검증되지 않음.

entries.aspect_ratio_note: 약 16:9, 내장 도구 원본 치수 그대로 저장. 재인코딩·크롭 없음.

entries.final_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one 16:9 photorealistic film insert first frame, C03 K06 records comparison. References: image 1 is the actual filmed scene and definitive prop/lighting continuity; image 2 is the approved scene reference, same Korean woman R, beige sleeves, teal vest, orange portfolio and gray ring binder on silver metal table. Create a close-up looking diagonally downward over R's RIGHT shoulder at the two OPEN files, in the exact same sunny outdoor delivery-yard situation. Frame ONLY the documents, the metal tabletop and minimal edges of her beige sleeve and hands, with a tiny soft edge of her right shoulder if needed. The woman's face, driver, delivery clipboard, phone and buildings are OUT OF FRAME. Critical spatial state: In the UPPER HALF of the frame R is holding the OPEN ORANGE PORTFOLIO in her hands, visibly lifted about 20–30 cm ABOVE the tabletop, angled toward her gaze and camera so its white INTERNAL PAPER PAGE is a large readable plane. Small support fingers at the bottom margin, not across the paper. In the LOWER HALF of the frame an OPEN GRAY RING BINDER lies FLAT ON THE METAL TABLE; its silver rings, gray cover edges and large white INTERNAL PAPER PAGE are visible. The orange folder must NOT lie on the table. Both white internal pages occupy substantial distinct areas of the shot, sharply focused and unobstructed, with natural perspective and clearly separated depth planes. Paper surfaces contain only sparse faint gray generic note lines and tiny abstract strokes near margins; leave broad uncluttered white central areas on BOTH pages for precise diagram compositing in later editing. Do not print diagonal cover stripes on the white pages, no large glyphs or charts, no readable text, no numbers, no invented logos. The documents must be recognized as opened files rather than loose sheets; keep orange cover edges behind upper page and gray ring binding around lower page. Anatomy plausible, minimal hands only, no duplicated fingers. Bright natural daylight, subtle true shadows proving the orange file is held above the table, realistic paper/fabric/brushed metal textures, reference color palette. Intended subsequent movement is only a very small camera push-in while both files, fingers and pages stay fixed. No new action in this still. Single widescreen 16:9 image, no collage, no caption, no watermark.
entries.aspect_ratio_note: 약 16:9, 내장 도구 원본 치수 그대로 저장. 재인코딩·크롭 없음.
entries.motion_camera_notes: R의 오른쪽 어깨 너머 비스듬한 하향 근접. 주황 파일은 펼쳐 든 채 탁자 위 공중에 고정, 회색 링 파일은 금속 탁자에 펼친 채 고정. 두 내부 흰 페이지를 크게 유지하며 카메라만 아주 조금 전진. 손/페이지/파일 움직임 없음. 두 페이지의 정확한 조건 도식은 후편집으로 삽입. 현재 희미한 일반선은 행사의 실제 정보가 아님.

observations: 주황 파일은 손에 들려 탁자에서 떨어진 상태, 회색 링 파일은 금속 탁자 위 상태를 구분.
두 흰 내부 페이지에 넓은 합성 여백. 사람 얼굴·기사·운송장·스마트폰 제외.
베이지 소매·청록 조끼의 일부와 손만 노출. 손 형태에 눈에 띄는 오류 없음.
remaining_checks: 저장 파일 재열람 완료. 세 명의 독립·교차 검수 대기.
후속 영상의 두 파일 높이·페이지 형태 고정과 도식 합성 가독성은 생성/편집 후 검증 필요.
